buffers.drums:
setcps(0.5)
stack(
  s("bd*4"),
  s("~ sd ~ sd").bank("tr909"),
  s("hh*8").gain(0.5),
  s("~ ~ ~ oh").gain(0.4)
)
buffers.bass:
setcps(0.55)
stack(
  s("bd*4, ~ cp"),
  note("<c2 c2 ab1 bb1>*4").s("sawtooth").lpf(600).lpq(6).decay(0.15).sustain(0),
  s("hh*8").gain(0.4)
)
buffers.chords:
setcps(0.45)
stack(
  chord("<Cm7 Fm7 Bb7 Ebmaj7>").voicing().s("gm_epiano1").room(0.3),
  note("<c2 f2 bb1 eb2>").s("triangle").gain(0.8),
  s("bd ~ ~ bd, ~ sd").bank("rolandtr808")
)
buffers.melody:
setcps(0.5)
stack(
  n("0 2 4 <5 7> 4 2 0 ~").scale("D:dorian").s("square").lpf(1800).gain(0.5),
  note("d2 ~ a1 ~").s("sawtooth").lpf(500),
  s("bd ~ sd ~, hh*8")
)

  s("hh*16").gain(".6 .3").pan(sine.fast(2))
)
